19 And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God. 20 Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us, (Ephesians 3:19-20 KJV)

The Greek word “GINOSKO” that was translated “know” in this verse means experiential knowledge, so it is saying that we should experience the love of Christ, which passes just knowing about His love. One of the most important things a Christian can do is to experience the true Love of God, as it will make your relationship with Him come alive. Your understanding of God’s love is a must, for you to enjoy all the benefits of being a Christian. To be full of God, you must experience His love, as God is love (1 John 4:8). Also you can not give God’s kind of love to others, if you have not received it yourself, as you can not give away what you don’t have. Understanding just how much God loves us is necessary to be able to live the Christian life, and love our neighbor as ourselves (Matthew 22:39). It is absolutely impossible to show God’s love to others in our natural ability. You must die to yourself and let Christ live through you, to be able to live a godly life.

Most people only believe the first part of verse 20, as the church likes to teach that God is sovereign, meaning in total control of everything that happens in life. That is not true, as the last part of this verse explains, that God flows through His people, and does not control everything independent of us, as He has limited Himself to working through humans. God is Almighty, and His overall will must come to pass, but He does not sovereignty control all that happens. To believe that God controls everything would make Him responsible for all the terrible things that happen in this world, and is totally inconsistent with the fact that God is love (1 John 4:8). If you know God’s love, you will never believe that He causes the bad things in our lives (James 1:17). Saying that God causes the bad things in life that the devil causes, is blasphemy against the Holy Ghost, and can send a born again Christian to hell (Matthew 12:31-32).
